  • Constructor Details

    • Notification

      public Notification(Integer id, Integer accountId, String message, Boolean isRead, Long creationDate, Integer senderID, String type, Integer repairId)
      Constructor that assigns attributes to a Notification
      Parameters:
      id - Id of the notification
      accountId - Id of the destination account of the notification, null if it was a manager
      message - Message contained in the notification
      isRead - if the notification was or not opend
      creationDate - date when the notification was created
      senderID - id of the account that send the notification, null if it was a manager
      type - type of notification, so the program can know what to do with each one
      repairId - id of the repair in question in the notification, if the notification is not about a repair is null
